target.definition: Number of recreation visits to Yellowstone National Park during August 2026, as reported in NPS monthly visitation statistics.

inputs.name: annual_visits_2025
inputs.description: Total recreation visits to Yellowstone National Park in calendar year 2025.

provenance.quote: Yellowstone hosted 4.7 million recreation visits in 2024

inputs.name: august_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of Yellowstone's annual recreation visits that occur in August.

provenance.rationale: August is the peak month; NPS monthly data typically show July and August each around 20–25% of annual visits.

inputs.name: summer_visits_2026
inputs.description: Total recreation visits to Yellowstone during the 2026 summer season (June–August).

provenance.rationale: Summer season typically accounts for about half of annual visits; 2026 expected similar to recent years.

inputs.name: august_share_of_summer
inputs.description: Fraction of summer-season visits that occur in August.

provenance.rationale: August is one of three summer months; July often slightly higher, June slightly lower, so August share near one-third to 40%.

inputs.name: daily_visits_peak_august
inputs.description: Average daily recreation visits to Yellowstone during August.

provenance.rationale: Peak summer days often see 20,000–30,000 visits; August average around 25,000.

inputs.name: us_population
inputs.description: Population of the United States in 2026.

provenance.quote: U.S. population is approximately 340 million in 2026

inputs.name: annual_visits_per_capita
inputs.description: Annual recreation visits to Yellowstone per U.S. resident.

provenance.rationale: 4.8 million annual visits divided by 340 million people gives about 0.014 visits per person per year.

inputs.name: august_share_of_annual_proxy
inputs.description: Fraction of annual visits occurring in August, used as a proxy scaling factor.

provenance.rationale: Same as august_share_of_annual; used in proxy path to scale per-capita annual visits.

paths.description: Estimate August 2026 visits as a share of projected annual 2026 visits.
Estimate August 2026 visits from average daily visits times days in August.
Scale U.S. population by per-capita annual visits and August share.
